fuel_type.note: gasoline, none (corded electric, cordless/battery, or manual hand tools)

fuel_consumption_l_per_min.note: liters per IN-GAME minute of use (40 real minutes = 1 full in-game day = 1440 in-game minutes at 1x speed); 0 for non-gas tools

power_draw_w.note: watts drawn while running, for corded electric tools only. 0 for gas, cordless/battery (not drawing wall power during use), and manual hand tools.

tank_capacity_l.note: liters the tool's own onboard fuel tank holds (gas tools only). 0 for everything else.
